reviewScope: 18 individually reviewed body images from 5 current-corpus DOI; marker is evidence identity only, human/model semantic review is recorded separately.
resolutionBoundary: ACS SVG preserved as source SVG. JACS PNG sources are 520 px wide and Nature WebP sources 685 px wide; accepted as legible current captured body figures, not asserted as publisher maximum resolution.
